spans.s:
Ma (IE 8-1), abbreviation of Maṅgala-vāra, Tuesday.
 (PJS), abbreviation of Mahattama, Mantrin, Mahetā (meaning ‘a clerk’ or ‘a teacher’ in Gujarātī), etc. (especially in medieval Jain inscriptions).

mar̤uturu (IE 8-6; CITD); also called mar̤utu, mattaru, etc.; Telugu; Kannaḍa mattar or mattaru; a certain land measure of uncertain area generally used as an equivalent^1 of nivartana, different kinds being mentioned as kāl-mar̤uturu, ghaḍa-mar̤uturu, kommu-mar̤utu, etc.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210207. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/51.
mā (IE 8-6; SII 12; SITI), Tamil; a land measure equal to one-twentieth of a veli; also the name of a weight.
